newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Offers quoted flat to lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Offers quoted flat to lower.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were offered steady to lower on Monday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges were traded versus none on Friday.
- Two barges, Illinois River, this week, bid 100 percent, unchanged from Friday, offer 105 percent, down 2-1/2 percentage points from Friday.
- Two barges, Illinois River, next week, bid 100 percent, no comparison, offer 105 percent, no comparison.
